attributes.action: Please save Radio 4 Extra, its our BBC radio heritage and is very entertaining.
attributes.additional_details:
The BBC are about to stop the best spoken word radio station to save money for some of the awfully woke TV shows they broadcast. Please stop the BBC from cancelling Radio 4 Extra.
Radio 4 Extra has access to the vast archives of BBC programmes and is very entertaining. I listen to it while driving and at home and enjoy it immensely. Please save our radio heritage and support this petition to keep Radio 4 Extra broadcasting.
